title: Report Builder Formulas: Calculated Fields, Labels and Rates | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
The data of a report rarely has the number you need: minutes instead of seconds, a Long or Short label, an answer rate. A calculated field in the CrestApps Report Builder works it out with a formula, like a spreadsheet. This video builds five calculated fields.

In this video:
• Why formulas
• Adding a calculated field: label, name, formula, Check and Apply
• Dragging it onto Columns
• Labels with IF, filling gaps with COALESCE, and dates with DATEDIFF
• Formulas that work once per group: an answer rate for each queue
• The Functions list, and what Check says when a formula is wrong
